g.title: J_OBC_ACC
g.text: OBC J9: PA13, PA14, NRST, PD8, PD9, PB8, TPS3850 SET0

g.title: W8A
g.text: internal, flown; through a wall gap to the access window

g.title: J_ACCESS
g.text: 2x5 2.54 mm shrouded bulkhead header (harness designer's part)
at the access window, -Y face, -Z end zone; internal side W8A, external side the GSE plug

g.title: W8
g.text: Ground support only; removed before flight with the RBF pin. The GSE UART adapter must be powered from VTREF (its RX line otherwise back-powers an unpowered OBC: 10 k series on the OBC limits it to 0.3 mA)

g.title: P_GSE
g.text: GSE cable: SWD probe (VTREF sense only) and a 3.3 V USB-UART referenced to VTREF; pin 9 jumpered to pin 1; WDT_DIS switch to VTREF
